707404.t: From καταρράσσω (katarrhā́ssō) + -της (-tēs), the former from κατα- (kata-, “down”) + ῥάσσω (rhā́ssō, “to strike, dash”).

707406.t: From κατα- (kătă-, “downwards, down”) + ῥέω (rhéō, “to flow, run, stream, gush”).

707482.t: From κατα- (kata-, “downwards”) + φρονέω (phronéō, “to think, to be arrogant”).

707419.t: κατα- (kata-, strengthening prefix) + σκευάζω (skeuázō, “equip”), from σκευή (skeuḗ, “equipment”) + -άζω (-ázō, denominative verb suffix).

707492.t: From κατά (katá, “under, down”) + χράομαι (khrắomai, “to use, make use of, take part in, manage, administer”).

707436.t: From the root of καθίστημι (kathístēmi) + -σις (-sis); also analyzable as κατα- (kata-) + στάσις (stásis).

707494.t: From κατα- (kata-, “down, thoroughly”) + χρίω (khrī́ō, “to rub, smear; anoint”).
